liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet>Fire is jammy but lacks the energy of most others; Scarlet/Fire is described as hot and energetic [23][25]
- **Deal** (1 review): The Deal closing the first set was singled out as especially hot [18]
- **Turn on Your Lovelight** (1 review): Bobby delivers a nice Lovelight, with Phil's bass thumping throughout the night [18]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): Masterpiece sounds especially crisp on this recording [21]
- **Attics of My Life** (1 review): Attics is named the undoubted highlight of the night [23]
- Reviewer picks the encore Knockin' On Heaven's Door as the highlight of the show [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd93-03-28 t01 Mississippi Half-Step**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd93-03-28 t02 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd93-03-28 t03 So Many Roads**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd93-03-28 t04 When I Paint My Masterpiece**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd93-03-28 t05 High Time**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd93-03-28 t06 Eternity**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd93-03-28 t07 Deal**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd93-03-28 t08 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-03-28.139671.fob.schoeps.wise.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 160 min [1]
- **gd93-03-28.sbd.nawrocki.16747.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 176 min; rated 4.17/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: The ST-250 audience source sounds immersive, with Phil's bass big and better than on the soundboard, which seems stale [20]
- **gd1993-03-28.154758.mtx.seamons.ht136.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 157 min [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard clicks and pops were cleaned up; minor anomalies remain; Soundboard has phasey vocal effects on Attics and Knockin' On Heaven's Door [4]
- **gd93-03-28.ST250.georges.5702.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience recording quality is not the best, but it captures the experience; The audience tapes of these shows are very bassy [22][26]
- **gd1993-03-28.akg.andrewf.95961.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [8]. Said about its sound: A sub-second digital zap occurs in Half-Step at about 0:59 [8]

## Around the show

- The crowd around the taper is attentive to the music, with little off-topic chatter [22]
- Albany welcomed a peaceful crowd, and the Knick's sound and vibe were fantastic [26]
- Attendee recalls Albany as a special place while touring with the band [27]
- Reviewer was a high school senior who hung around the arena's outside scene and drum circles [28]
- Scarlet > Fire is likened to the 6/12/92 show at the Knick [18]
- Judged the best night of the run and possibly the best of that tour [20]
- Finds this show weaker than most Spring 93 shows; considers 3-27 the best night of the run [23]
- Attended both nights and found this one better than 3/27, which seemed uninspired and sloppy [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-03-28.139671.fob.schoeps.wise.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Jim Wise and Scott Clugston; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Jim Wise's FOB Audience DAT > Schoeps CMC6/MK4 (hand-held ORTF) > Sonosax SX-M2 > Dat (Sony D10 Pro/48k); Transfer Info: DAT Master… [1]. Also: Schoeps microphone recording, with Wise and Clugston credited in the file name [1]
- **gd93-03-28.sbd.nawrocki.16747.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>C>DAT>CDR encoded by Dan Carr [2]
- **gd1993-03-28.154758.mtx.seamons.ht136.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Soundtrack Pro [4]
- **gd93-03-28.ST250.georges.5702.sbeok.shnf**: taped by James Young; transferred by Nick Georges; source: Audience: Soundfield ST-250 [5]
- **gd1993-03-28.akg.andrewf.95961.flac1648**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AKG C460B/CK8 shotguns > unknown lead dat decks > Coax SPDIF > Casio DA-7 > Maxell DM-120's, front of OTS. [8]. Also: AKG-mic recording by Andrew F, 48 kHz version, patched from ShnID 5702 at So Many Roads [8]
